NOT CLAIMED: captures are a patched part. An element carries what its
handler reads as rendered; the store reads only item.id, the loop key.
NOT CLAIMED: an opaque type's invariant is checked at the boundary.
PositiveInt arrives as an s64; the language states no invariant for it.
NOT CLAIMED: handler parameters, local computation, branches, or
multi-statement bodies compile. Each is refused by name.
